baseline.calibration: published rectified intrinsics, arbitrary unit baseline
limitations: Two real calibrated stereo photos only; no 360 object scan
Open camera-visible surfaces, no filled holes or unobserved backside
Vertex colors are sampled; no photographic UV texture atlas
Baseline scale arbitrary; cannot claim dimensions in millimeters
Vertex errors and fixed-pixel coverage evaluate only the left stereo image, not whole-object completeness

baselineBuild: git archive 561f5e77 reconstruction to isolated /tmp/rf-baseline; g++ -std=c++20 -O2 -shared -fPIC with core,pnp,multiview,bundle_adjustment,dense,surface,texture,photometric,cancellation,depth_checkpoint sources
evaluation: Nearest triangle depth at fixed original left-image pixel centers; reciprocal-depth interpolation; valid GT disparity mask; accurate coverage requires relative depth error <5%; all GT consulted only after reconstruction.

integrated.calibration: published rectified intrinsics, arbitrary unit baseline
limitations: Two real calibrated stereo photos only; no 360 object scan
Open camera-visible surfaces, no filled holes or unobserved backside
Vertex colors are sampled; no photographic UV texture atlas
Baseline scale arbitrary; cannot claim dimensions in millimeters
Vertex errors and fixed-pixel coverage evaluate only the left stereo image, not whole-object completeness
Single real calibrated stereo pair, not a full object or Android performance claim
Overlapping faces do not add pixel coverage
Ground-truth invalid regions excluded; unknown sides unmeasured
purpose: Replace welding-count heuristic with independently measured left-image surface accuracy and coverage
